description: Applies to one job by job_match_id or job_url, or to up to 10 jobs under one yes by job_match_ids, on the employer's own hiring system; for a job-board link, GetMattered first looks for the employer's own posting. mode "auto" submits, "review" holds for approval, and no mode follows the account setting. A sent application cannot be withdrawn. When GetMattered cannot apply, nothing is sent, and the answer says why and whether the job stays on the user's GetMattered board.

job_match_id.description: The job_match_id of a match from getmattered_get_matches (e.g. 48213). Either this or job_url.

job_match_ids.description: Up to 10 job_match_ids from getmattered_get_matches, applied to under one confirmation (e.g. [48213, 48214]). Each job gets its own result.

job_url.description: Link to any job posting to apply to. Either this or job_match_id, which identifies a job from getmattered_get_matches.

mode.description: "auto" submits with no review step. "review" holds the prepared application for the user's approval. Left out, the user's account setting decides. Applies to this application only.

name: getmattered_apply

alreadyExisted.description: True when this job already had an application. The answer holds that application, and no second one starts.

applicationId.description: The application to follow with getmattered_get_applications. Null only when nothing was started.

employerConfirmed.description: True ONLY when the employer sent a receipt or showed its confirmation page. False right after an apply.

host.description: The host of the job_url, when one was given.

kept.description: True when nothing was sent and the job stays on the user's GetMattered board, at trackingUrl. GetMattered tells the user once it can send it, unless reason is account_only_board.

notice.description: Present when the confirmation form got no answer: the application is held for approval and nothing was sent.

outcome.description: started: a new application; already_in_progress: this job already had one (alreadyExisted); not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent; not_applied: nothing was sent, see reason and userAction; batch: a job_match_ids call, with one entry per job in results.

reason.description: Null when a new application started. unsupported_host: GetMattered does not submit on that hiring system. posting_not_found: the employer has no posting at that link. import_failed: the posting could not be read or saved. no_employer_posting: the job-board posting was read, and GetMattered found no employer posting it sends on. account_only_board: the employer takes this job on a job board that needs that board's own account (Y Combinator's Work at a Startup), where GetMattered does not send. already_applied: this job already has an application. Nothing is sent for any reason. kept says whether the job stays on the user's GetMattered board.

reasonDetail.description: Why the posting could not be read, in words ready for the user. Present with import_failed.

results.description: One entry per job of a job_match_ids call, in the order given. Empty when one job was named.

outcome.description: started: a new application; already_in_progress: this job already had one; not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent; not_applied: nothing was sent, see reason and userAction; not_started: this call ran out of time before this job, nothing was sent; unconfirmed: the answer did not arrive in time, and the application may have started; getmattered_get_applications shows whether it did.

reason.description: Why this job did not start a new application, as in the top-level reason. Null when it started, or when the cause is in userAction.

status.description: Our own record, which is not proof the employer received it.

userAction.description: What the user can do next for this job, in words ready for the user. Null when it started.

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

status.description: Our own record, which is not proof the employer received it.

userAction.description: What the user can do next, in words ready for the user. Null when a new application started.

title: Apply to Job
